record.question: Which of the following is not a phase of New Drug Development?
record.explanation: Answer D: Drug repurposing studies. Synthesis/isolation, preclinical work, clinical studies, and postmarketing surveillance are recognized stages; “drug repurposing studies” is a strategy that can occur across development, not a formal phase. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/patients/drug-development-process. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
